limitations: Two independent launches per arm; exploratory, not a broad stability guarantee.
One APU, fixed synthetic inputs and 128-token outputs; no warm cache, concurrency, vision, or Agent task-quality claim.
Prefill/decode are engine steady-clock phase times. Full request is client wall time excluding process startup, loading, tokenization and cleanup.
Pinning applies only to the large FP32 indexer projection; it does not eliminate clocks, temperature, OS activity or all kernel-choice variation.

captures.scope: Full captured cold input streams and last-row d_R/full target logits at common absolute endpoints only. Single-sided intermediate endpoints are not compared. No full KV/GDN/MTP state, all hidden rows, unrecorded boundaries, general answer correctness, or timing equivalence.

secondary_complete_stage_profiles.rules: Stage call count must exactly match the expected layer count; each counted span passed the production timing guard. Pair by request length and base. Invalid/missing stages are not zero-filled. This secondary diagnostic does not change whole-chunk exclusions.

details.ground_truth_method: Independent Python grouping and integer arithmetic, not the agent SQL.

submission.summary: 重写parse_amount_cents：仅接受str，去除首尾ASCII空白；严格按 可选+/-、可选¥/￥、整数部分（无逗号允许前导0；有逗号时首组1-3位、后续恰3位）、可选小数点后1-2位ASCII数字 逐字符校验（用'0123456789'成员判断，拒绝Unicode数字如１、下划线、指数、NaN、括号、内部空白、多余小数点等）；用纯整数运算计算分（不再用float/round，避免精度误差），绝对值超999999999.99元抛ValueError，负号取负（负零自然归0）。公共测试18/18通过。
